note: v1 of intent_cases_draft.json. Changes: single-intent spans are the whole question; kind 'multi_same_intent' merged into 'single' (boundary note kept); expected_in_scope explicit on every case; 'targets' = registry product IDs that the planner's task.request must name (subject restoration); added same-product alias, partial out-of-scope, CTG-only, guideline+product and 5 real first-turn service questions (kind real_service, original wording). Spans are verbatim substrings of the question. Expected values were set by the assistant and an external review; not yet confirmed by a domain expert.
